summary.evidence: lower time in every pair, beyond control spread
lower time in every pair, beyond control spread

methodology: Four balanced comparison pairs and two identical-baseline control pairs, one implementation per fresh Chrome process. React production build; preloaded modules; 150ms warmup per case; 12 untrimmed samples; fixed identical iteration counts. Includes synchronous React/DOM and forced layout, excludes network/module startup and paint. No application latency claim.
